Start high above as he lowers into a crouched off-balance step between the rose chair and folded screen. As he turns, drop the camera quickly to his face and pull closer. He lands sitting diagonally with one knee raised, smiles sheepishly, raises an open left hand, and holds the solid decoration from the reference up beside his chest. Preserve the down-and-up movement and render the final seated close-up before the cut. Only one person, no extra camera cuts, no weapons, no captions or dialogue.
